feat:ability-improvement: • Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1, up to a maximum of 20.
feat:actor:
• Your Charisma ability score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
• You gain expertise in Deception and Performance.
• If not already proficient, the character also gains proficiency in the chosen skills.
feat:alert: • You gain a +5 bonus to initiative and can't be Surprised.
feat:athlete:
• Your Strength or Dexterity ability score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
• When you are Prone, standing up uses significantly less movement.
• Your Jump distance also increases by 50%.
feat:charger:
• Charge forward and slam your weapon into the first enemy in your way without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
• Charge forward and Shove the first enemy in your way without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
• Shove distance depends on your Strength and the target's weight.
• Charger: Weapon attack uses an Action and Bonus Action, moves up to 9 m (30 ft), and makes a melee attack with +5 damage.
• This counts as a single weapon attack, and benefits from Extra Attack.
feat:crossbow-expert:
• When you make crossbow attacks within melee range, the attack rolls do not have Disadvantage.
• Your Piercing Shot also inflicts Gaping Wounds for twice as long.
feat:defensive-duellist:
• When you are attacked with a melee attack while wielding a Finesse weapon you are proficient in, you can use a Reaction to increase your Armour Class by your proficiency bonus, possibly causing the attack to miss. Requires Dexterity to be at least 13.
• The weapon equipped in the main hand is required to have Finesse.
feat:dual-wielder:
• You can use Two-Weapon Fighting even if your weapons aren't Light.
• You cannot dual-wield Two-Handed weapons.
• You have a +1 bonus to Armour Class while wielding a melee weapon in each hand.
• This feat allows a creature to dual-wield weapons that are not Light, provided they are not Two-Handed. However, it does not grant the Two-Weapon Fighting Style; without this Style, the wielder still does not add their Ability Modifier to off-hand melee damage rolls with any weapon.
• Simple melee weapons: Javelins, Maces, Quarterstaves, and Spears
• Martial melee weapons: Battleaxes, Flails, Longswords, Morningstars, Rapiers, Tridents, War Picks, and Warhammers
feat:dungeon-delver:
• You gain Advantage on Perception checks made to detect hidden objects and on Saving Throws made to avoid or resist traps.
• You gain resistance to the damage dealt by traps.
feat:durable:
• Your Constitution ability score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
• Regain full hit points every time you take a short rest.
• Bug: The ability score increase follows the priority order for capped bonuses.
• In Wild Shape form,[1]
• Bug: The ability score increase applies.
• The full HP on a short rest applies.
• The HP increase does not apply.
feat:elemental-adept:
• Your spells and attacks ignore resistance to a damage type of your choice. In addition, when you deal that type of damage with a spell, you cannot roll a 1.
• Damage resistance options are one of the following:
• Elemental Adept: Acid
• Elemental Adept: Cold
• Elemental Adept: Lightning
• Elemental Adept: Fire
• Elemental Adept: Thunder
• "You cannot roll a 1" means that whenever a 1 is rolled on a damage die, it is treated as a 2 instead.
feat:great-weapon-master:
• When an attack with a melee weapon lands a Critical Hit or kills a creature, you can make another melee weapon attack as a Bonus Action that turn.
• When attacking with a Two-Handed or Versatile melee weapon (in both hands) that you are Proficient with, Attack Rolls take a -5 penalty, but their damage increases by 10.
• All In is a toggleable passive ability.
feat:heavily-armoured:
• Your Strength ability score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
• Gain Proficiency with Heavy armour.
• Requires Medium armour Proficiency.
• Bug: The ability score increase follows the priority order for capped bonuses.
• Bug: The ability score increase applies in Wild Shape form.[1]
feat:heavy-armour-master:
• Your Strength ability score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
• Incoming damage from non-magical attacks also decreases by 3 while you're wearing heavy armour.
• Requires Heavy armour Proficiency.
• Bug: All sources of ⁠Slashing, ⁠Bludgeoning, and ⁠Piercing damage, magical or not, are reduced. Other sources, such as elemental damage, are not affected.
• Bug: The ability score increase follows the priority order for capped bonuses.
• Bug: The ability score increase applies in Wild Shape form.[1]
feat:lightly-armoured:
• Your Strength or Dexterity ability score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
• Gain Proficiency with Light armour.
feat:lucky:
• You gain 3 Luck Points that recharge after a Long Rest.
• You can use a Luck Point to gain Advantage on your next Ability Check.
• You can use a Luck Point to gain Advantage on your next Attack Roll or Saving Throw, or to make an enemy reroll their Attack Roll.
feat:mage-slayer:
• When a creature casts a Spell within melee range of you, you have Advantage on any Saving Throws against it.
• You can use a Reaction to immediately make an attack against the caster if it casts a spell within 1.5m / 5ft of you.
• Enemies you hit have Disadvantage when making Saving Throws to maintain their Concentration.
feat:magic-initiate-bard: • Learn 2 Cantrips and a 1st-level Spell from the Bard spell list. You can cast the 1st-level Spell once per Long Rest. Your Spellcasting Ability for all three spells is Charisma.
feat:magic-initiate-cleric:
• Learn 2 Cantrips and a 1st-level Spell from the Cleric spell list. You can cast the 1st-level Spell once per Long Rest. Your Spellcasting Ability for all three spells is Wisdom.
• Bug: While wearing medium armour, the bonus to Armour Class you can gain from your Dexterity modifier also becomes +3 instead of +2.
• The AC bonus increase is not listed in-game, and can also be gained by taking the Medium Armour Master feat.
feat:magic-initiate-druid: • Learn 2 Cantrips and a 1st-level Spell from the Druid spell list. You can cast the 1st-level Spell once per Long Rest. Your Spellcasting Ability for all three spells is Wisdom.
feat:magic-initiate-sorcerer:
• Learn 2 Cantrips and a 1st-level Spell from the Sorcerer spell list. You can cast the 1st-level Spell once per Long Rest. Your Spellcasting Ability for all three spells is Charisma.
• Bug: If Shield is provided by this feat, then it uses spell slots like an ordinary spell without a once-per-long-rest restriction. This means that it cannot be used at all by a character with no spell slots.
feat:magic-initiate-warlock: • Learn 2 Cantrips and a 1st-level Spell from the Warlock spell list. You can cast the 1st-level Spell once per Long Rest. Your Spellcasting Ability for all three spells is Charisma.
feat:magic-initiate-wizard:
• Learn 2 Cantrips and a 1st-level Spell from the Wizard spell list. You can cast the 1st-level Spell once per Long Rest. Your Spellcasting Ability for all three spells is Intelligence.
• Bug: If Shield is provided by this feat, then it uses spell slots like an ordinary spell without a once-per-long-rest restriction. This means that it cannot be used at all by a character with no spell slots.
feat:martial-adept: • Learn two Manoeuvres from the Battle Master archetype and receive 1 (additional) Superiority Die to fuel them. You regain expended Superiority Dice after a Short or Long Rest.
feat:medium-armour-master:
• When you wear medium armour, it doesn't impose Disadvantage on Stealth checks. The bonus to Armour Class you can gain from your Dexterity modifier also becomes +3 instead of +2.
• Requires Medium armour Proficiency.
feat:mobile:
• Your Movement Speed increases by 3 m (10 ft).
• When you use the Dash action, Difficult Terrain doesn't slow you down.
• If you move after making a melee attack, you don't provoke an Opportunity Attack from that target.
feat:moderately-armoured:
• Your Strength or Dexterity ability score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
• Gain Proficiency with Medium armour and Shields.
feat:performer:
• Your Charisma ability score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
• Gain Musical Instrument Proficiency.
feat:polearm-master:
• When attacking with a Glaive, Halberd, Pike, Quarterstaff, or Spear, you can use a Bonus Action to attack with the butt of your weapon.
• You can also make an Opportunity Attack when a target comes within range.
• The damage modifier of this attack uses Strength or Dexterity, whichever is higher, even if the weapon does not have the finesse property. This is still true when using Shillelagh.
• Polearm Master works with Pikes even though this is not stated in-game. (see [2])
• If chosen as a feat during level-up, there is no indication of this later under "Notable Features" on the character sheet. Furthermore, the passives Polearm Master: Bonus Attack and Polearm Master: Opportunity Attack are situational actions and are only visible on the hotbar in combat.
feat:resilient:
• You increase an Ability by 1, to a maximum of 20.
• Gain Proficiency in that ability's Saving Throws.
• The available passive features are:
• Resilient: Strength
• Resilient: Dexterity
• Resilient: Constitution
• Resilient: Intelligence
• Resilient: Wisdom
• Resilient: Charisma
• Bug: The ability score increase follows the priority order for capped bonuses.
• Bug: The ability score increase to Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution applies in Wild Shape form.[1]
feat:ritual-caster:
• You learn two Ritual spells of your choice.
• The available spells are:
• Speak with Dead
• Find Familiar
• Longstrider
• Enhance Leap
• Disguise Self
• Speak with Animals
• The version of Find Familiar granted by this feat has a separate once per short rest cooldown not shared with the spellbook version. Knowing both versions of Find Familiar will allow a caster to summon multiple familiars per short rest, though they are still limited to one familiar active at a time.
feat:savage-attacker: • When making melee weapon attacks, you roll your damage dice twice and use the highest result.
feat:sentinel:
• When an enemy in melee range attacks an ally, you can use a Reaction to make a weapon attack against that enemy. Target ally must not have the Sentinel feat.
• When you hit a creature with an Opportunity Attack, it can no longer move for the rest of its turn.
• You gain Advantage on Opportunity Attacks.
feat:sharpshooter:
• Your ranged weapon attacks are not penalized for High Ground Rules.
• Ranged weapon attacks with weapons you are Proficient with have a -5 penalty to their Attack Roll, but deal an additional 10 damage.
• All In is a toggleable passive ability.
feat:shield-master:
• Gain a +2 bonus to Dexterity Saving Throw when wielding a Shield.
• If a Spell forces you to make a Dexterity Saving Throw, you can use your Reaction to shield yourself and diminish the effect's damage.
• - On a failed save, you only take half damage.
• - On a successful save, you don't take any damage, even if you normally would.
• Bug: This feat does not reduce the damage taken on a failed save.
• Unlike the DnD counterpart, this feat doesn't take shield AC into account and instead only offers a flat bonus to Dexterity Saving Throw.
feat:skilled: • You gain Proficiency in 3 Skills of your choice.
feat:spell-sniper:
• You learn a cantrip, and the number you need to roll a Critical Hit while attacking with a Spell is reduced by 1. This effect can stack.
• The available cantrips are:
• Bone Chill
• Eldritch Blast
• Fire Bolt
• Ray of Frost
• Shocking Grasp
• Thorn Whip
• These cantrips use the character's Spellcasting Ability. For example, if a Cleric chooses Eldritch Blast with this feat, they use their Wisdom modifier and not their Charisma modifier.
• All available cantrips are Spell Attacks and use Attack Roll
feat:tavern-brawler:
• Your Strength or Constitution ability score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
• When you make an unarmed attack, use an improvised weapon, or throw something, your strength modifier is added twice to the damage and Attack Roll.
• Unarmed attacks that use Dexterity as a modifier still gain the strength modifier as a bonus with this feat and thus don't get the Dexterity modifier applied twice to the attack.
feat:tough: • Hit Point maximum increased by 2 for each level.
feat:war-caster:
• You gain Advantage on Saving Throws to maintain Concentration on a Spell.
• You can also use a Reaction to cast Shocking Grasp at a target moving out of melee range.
• This feat does not grant the ability to use Shocking Grasp at will. Unless you know it from another source, you can only use it as an Attack of Opportunity.
• Casting Shocking Grasp as an Attack of Opportunity uses the character's Spellcasting Ability. For example, if a Cleric casts Shocking Grasp with this feat, they use their Wisdom modifier.
feat:weapon-master:
• Your Strength or Dexterity ability score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
• Gain Proficiency with four Weapon types of your choice.

feature:abjuration-savant: Halves the cost to learn Abjuration spells from scrolls.
feature:abjure-enemy: Frighten an enemy. They have Disadvantage on ability checks and Attack Rolls, and they cannot move.
feature:accursed-spectre: When you or an ally within 18 m (60 ft) slay a creature that is afflicted with Hexblade's Curse, you can raise an Accursed Spectre that will fight alongside you for a short period of time.
feature:acid-breath: Spew forth a line of acid.
feature:acolyte-of-nature:
Learn a cantrip from the Druid spell list
Get one of the following proficiencies:
• Animal Handling
• Nature
• Survival
feature:action-surge: Immediately gain an extra Action to use this turn.
feature:advanced-unarmoured-movement: Difficult Terrain doesn't slow you down and you can Jump an additional 6 m (20 ft) while you are not wearing armour or using a shield.
feature:arcane-recovery: Replenish Spell Slots while out of combat. You cannot restore spell slots above 5th level.
feature:arcane-ward: The residual magic of your spells forms a ward around you that protects you from harm.
feature:armour-of-hexes: When a creature you cursed with Hexblade's Curse attacks you, potentially nullify the attack as a reaction. This has a 50% chance of succeeding.
feature:artificers-lore: Add twice your Proficiency Bonus to History checks.
feature:assassinate-ambush: Any successful Attack Roll against a Surprised creature is a Critical Hit.
feature:assassinate-initiative: You are deadliest against unprepared enemies. In combat, you have Advantage on Attack Rolls against creatures that haven't taken a turn yet.
feature:assassins-alacrity: Quick as an alley cat in a rain-dark city, you immediately restore your Action and Bonus Action at the start of combat
feature:astral-knowledge: Gain Proficiency in all Skills of a chosen Ability.
feature:aura-of-courage: You and any nearby allies can't be Frightened. The aura disappears if you fall unconscious.
feature:aura-of-devotion: You and any nearby allies can't be Charmed. The aura disappears if you fall unconscious.
feature:aura-of-hate: You and any nearby fiends and undead gain additional damage to melee weapon attacks equal to your Charisma Modifier.
feature:aura-of-protection: You and nearby allies gain a bonus to Saving Throws equal to your Charisma modifier. The aura disappears if you fall Unconscious.
feature:aura-of-warding: You and any nearby allies take only half the damage from spells.
feature:barbarian-lands-stride-difficult: You have become an expert at moving through the wilderness. Difficult Terrain no longer slows you down.
feature:barbarian-lands-stride-plants:
You have become an expert at moving through the wilderness.
Plant-based surfaces with thorns, spines, or similar hazards no longer harm you.
feature:bardic-inspiration: Inspire an ally to go beyond their capabilities with your performance. They can add a +1d6 bonus to their next Attack Roll, Ability Check, or Saving Throw.
feature:beguiling-defences: You have built stoic barriers in your heart and mind, and cannot be Charmed.
feature:bend-luck:
Give a target a 1d4 bonus or penalty to Ability Checks.
You can also apply this bonus or penalty to a target's Attack Roll or Saving Throw as a Reaction.
feature:benign-transposition-teleport: Teleport to a nearby, unoccupied space, or swap places with an ally.
feature:bestial-fury: Grants all your companions an extra attack.
feature:bind-hexed-weapon: Bind to your main hand weapon. Its damage becomes magical, you cannot drop or throw it, and you become Proficient with it if you weren't already. When you attack with this weapon, there is a chance that Hexblade's Curse will be applied to the target.
feature:bladesong: Invoke the Bladesong. You gain a +2 bonus to Armour Class and your movement speed increases by 3 m (10 ft). You also gain Advantage in Acrobatics and a +2 to Constitution Saving Throws.
feature:blessed-healer:
Healing others heals you as well.
When you cast a healing spell of Level 1 or higher on another creature, you regain hit points equal to 2 + the spell's level Hit Points.
feature:blessing-of-the-trickster: Grant another creature Advantage on Stealth Checks.
feature:blessings-of-knowledge: Gain Expertise in two of the following Skills: Arcana, History, Nature, or Religion. Your Proficiency Bonus is doubled for Ability Checks made using these Skills.
feature:bolstering-magic-boon: You or an ally receive +1d4 bonus to Attack Rolls and Ability Checks for 10 turns.
feature:bolstering-magic-level-1-spell-s: You or an ally recover a Level 1 Spell Slot.
feature:bolstering-magic-level-2-spell-s: You or an ally recover a Level 2 Spell Slot.
feature:bolstering-magic-level-3-spell-s: You or an ally recover a Level 3 Spell Slot.
feature:boot-of-the-giants: Try to kick a target away. Your chances depend on your Athletics, and are higher if you're hidden or invisible.
feature:brave: You have Advantage on Saving Throws against Frightened.
feature:brutal-critical: You've trained to strike swift and true. When you land a Critical Hit, you roll an extra damage die as well as the normal additional critical die.
feature:champion-challenge: Challenge the enemies around you, compelling them to attack only you. Any attacks they might make against other targets have Disadvantage.
feature:channel-divinity-cloak-of-shadow: Wrap yourself in shadows to become Invisible if you are obscured.
feature:charm-animals-and-plants: Channel fey magic to Charm nearby beasts and plants.
feature:cheeky-tipple: You are Immune to the negative effects of being Drunk. Once per day, when you drink alcohol, you regain half your Ki Points (rounded down).
feature:civil-militia:
You have weapon proficiency with:
• Spears
• Pikes
• Halberds
• Glaives
• Light armour
• Shields
feature:cloak-of-shadows: Wrap yourself in shadows to become Invisible if you are obscured.
feature:combat-inspiration: Inspire an ally to add a +1d6 bonus to their next Attack Roll, Ability Check, Saving Throw, weapon damage, or Armour Class.
feature:combat-wild-shape:
As a bonus action, you can assume the form of a beast. You can transform twice per Short Rest.
This ability otherwise acts as Wild Shape.
feature:companions-bond: Your Ranger's Companions receive a bonus to Armour Class and damage equal to its Proficiency Bonus.
feature:conjuration-savant: Halves the cost to learn Conjuration spells from scrolls.
feature:control-undead: Use the power of your Oath to gain control over an undead creature. The undead will follow you around and attack your enemies.
feature:controlled-chaos: Foes may suffer a Wild Magic Surge while casting spells near your fluctuating magic.
feature:cosmic-omen: Whenever you Long Rest, you consult the stars for a Cosmic Omen of Weal or of Woe. The omen grants you the ability to increase (Weal) or decrease (Woe) Attack Rolls or Saving Throws, or (Weal only) to increase your allies' Ability Checks.
feature:countercharm: You and any allies within 9 m (30 ft) have Advantage on Saving Throws against being Charmed or Frightened.
feature:create-sorcery-points: Spend Spell Slots to gain Sorcery Points. The level of spell slot spent creates the equivalent number of Sorcery Points.
feature:create-spell-slot: Spend Sorcery Points to unlock a Spell Slot.
feature:cunning-action-dash: Cover more distance this turn: double your movement speed.
feature:cunning-action-disengage: Retreat safely. Moving won't provoke Opportunity Attacks.
feature:cunning-action-hide: Hide from enemies by succeeding at Stealth checks. Stick to the dark and avoid enemy sightlines. Attacking or casting a spell will reveal your location.
feature:curving-shot: When you miss with any magical ranged attack, use a Bonus Action to attack the next closest target with the same attack.
feature:cutting-words: Use your wit to distract a creature and sap its confidence.
feature:dampen-elements: When you or an ally gets hit with Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage, you can use your reaction to halve the attack's damage.
feature:danger-sense:
You sense when things aren't as they should be.
You have Advantage on Dexterity Saving Throws, such as against traps, spells, and surfaces.
To gain this benefit, you can't be Blinded or Incapacitated.
feature:dark-ones-blessing: Whenever you reduce a hostile creature to 0 Hit Points, this gift from your patron grants you Charisma modifier + Warlock level temporary hit points.
feature:dark-ones-own-luck: Call on your patron to change your fate and add a 1d10 to an Ability Check.
feature:darkvision: Can see in the dark up to 12 m (40 ft).
feature:deepened-pact: Pleased with your service, your otherworldly patron added new boons to the terms of your pact.
feature:defensive-flourish-melee: Attack defensively, increasing your Armour Class by 4 if you hit.
feature:defensive-flourish-ranged: Attack defensively, increasing your Armour Class by 4 if you hit.
feature:deflect-missiles: Use your reaction to reduce the damage from a ranged weapon attack by 1d10 + your Dexterity Modifier + your monk level.
feature:destroy-undead: When you successfully Turn an Undead creature, it also takes 4d6 Radiant.
feature:destructive-wrath: When you roll Thunder or Lightning damage, you can use your Channel Divinity to deal maximum damage instead.
feature:dirty-trick-flick-o-the-wrist: Flick your weapon at a target and possibly Disarm them.
feature:dirty-trick-sand-toss: Toss a handful of sand at your enemy and possibly Blind them.
feature:dirty-trick-vicious-mockery: Insult a creature: it has Disadvantage on its next Attack Roll.
feature:disciple-of-life: Your devotion empowers your healing Spells. When casting a healing spell, the target regains additional hit points equal to 2 + the spell's level Hit Points.
feature:divination-savant: Halves the cost to learn Divination spells from scrolls.
feature:divine-allegiance: When an ally within 1.5 m (5 ft) of you takes damage, you can use your Reaction to magically substitute your own health for your ally's, healing them by 2 × (Paladin level) Hit Points at the cost of taking 2 × (Paladin level) Radiant damage yourself.

feature:enraged-throw: Pick up an item or creature and throw it at a target, dealing additional damage and knocking it Prone.

feature:healing-radiance: Heal yourself and all nearby allies. Regain the same amount the next turn.

feature:oath-of-devotion-tenets:
Oath of Devotion paladins abide by the following tenets:
Courage. Stride dauntlessly into action.
Compassion. Show clemency when prudent, and lend your arm to those in need.
Duty. Tend your responsibilities, obey just laws, and support those entrusted to your care.
feature:oath-of-the-ancients-tenets:
Oath of the Ancients paladins abide by the following tenets:
Kindle the Light. Through your acts of mercy, kindness, and forgiveness, kindle the light of hope in the world, beating back despair.
Shelter the Light. Where there is good, beauty, love, and laughter in the world, stand against the wickedness that would swallow it. Where life flourishes, stand against the forces that would render it barren.
Preserve Your Own Light. Delight in song and laughter, in beauty and art. If you allow the light to die in your own heart, you can’t preserve it in the world.
Be the Light. Be a glorious beacon for all who live in despair. Let the light of your joy and courage shine forth in all your deeds.
feature:oath-of-the-crown-tenets:
Oath of the Crown paladins abide by the following tenets:
Law. Uphold civilisation and order.
Loyalty. Your word is your bond; without loyalty, oaths and laws are meaningless.
Responsibility. Deal with the consequences of your actions, and fulfil your duties and obligations.
feature:oath-of-vengeance-tenets:
Oath of Vengeance paladins abide by the following tenets:
Fight the Greater Evil. Exerting your wisdom, identify the higher morality in any given instance, and fight for it.
No Mercy for the Wicked. Chasten those who dole out their villainy by wiping their blight from the world forever.

feature:poison-breath: Spew forth a cone of poison.

feature:spiteful-suffering: Steep an enemy in the darkness that churns within you. The target takes 1d4 + Charisma Modifier Necrotic damage each turn and Attack Rolls against it have Advantage.
feature:split-enchantment: You know your enchantments inside and out. You can target 2 creatures with Enchantment spells that would normally only target 1 creature.
feature:spreading-spores: Seed an area in deadly spores that deal 2d8 Necrotic damage per turn to all creatures that inhale them, except you and your allies.
feature:stalkers-flurry: When you miss with a weapon attack, you can make another one for free.
feature:starry-form: You can expend a Wild Shape Charge to take on a Starry Form rather than transforming into a beast.
feature:starry-form-archer: A constellation of an archer appears on you. As a Bonus Action while in this Starry Form, you can cast Luminous Arrow.
feature:starry-form-chalice: A constellation of a life-giving chalice appears on you. Whenever you cast a healing spell that consumes a spell slot, you can cast Chalice Healing.
feature:starry-form-dragon:
A constellation of a wise dragon appears on you. When you make a Saving Throw to maintain Concentration on a spell, a roll result of 9 or lower is considered a 10.
As a Bonus Action while in this Starry Form, you can cast Dazzling Breath.
feature:step-of-the-wind-dash: Double your movement speed. Jump no longer requires a Bonus Action.
feature:step-of-the-wind-disengage: Move without triggering Opportunity Attacks. Jump no longer requires a Bonus Action.
feature:stillness-of-mind: If you are Charmed or Frightened, you automatically cast Stillness of Mind to remove the condition.
feature:stone-camouflage: You have Advantage on Stealth checks.
feature:storms-fury: When struck by a melee attack, you may deal Lightning damage to the attacker and possibly push them back 6 m (20 ft).
feature:strength-of-the-grave: After reaching 0 Hit Points, you regain 1 instead of becoming downed.
feature:strongheart-resilience: You have Advantage on Saving Throws against being Poisoned and Resistance to Poison damage.
feature:stunning-strike-melee: Spend a Ki Point to deal normal weapon damage and possibly Stun the target.
feature:stunning-strike-unarmed: Spend a Ki Point to deal normal unarmed damage and possibly Stun the target.
feature:superior-darkvision: Can see in the dark up to 24 m (80 ft).
feature:supreme-sneak: Blend into the environment so completely that you become Invisible.
feature:symbiotic-entity: Gain 4 temporary hit points per Druid level and deal an additional 1d6 Necrotic damage with weapon or unarmed attacks while you have them. Cast Halo of Spores with double damage.
feature:tempestuous-magic: After you cast a Level 1 Spell or higher you can Fly as a Bonus Action up to 9 m (30 ft) until the end of your turn without receiving Opportunity Attacks.
feature:third-eye-darkvision: You gain the ability to see in the dark out to a range of 24 m (80 ft)
feature:third-eye-see-invisibility: Become able to see Invisible creatures, and possibly reveal them to others.
feature:thought-shield-psychic-reflectio: Your patron doesn't appreciate attempts to attack your mind. When you take Psychic damage, your attacker takes the same damage.
feature:thought-shield-psychic-resistanc: An elder being shields your brain. You gain Resistance to Psychic damage.
feature:thunderbolt-strike: When you deal Thunder or Lightning damage to a creature that is Large or smaller, you can also push it up to 3 m (10 ft).
feature:tides-of-chaos:
Activate to gain Advantage on your next Attack Roll, Ability Check, or Saving Throw.
Increased chance of Wild Magic surge afterwards.
feature:tigers-bloodlust: Lash out to attack up to 3 enemies at once. They each take half the damage your weapon usually deals and start to Bleed.
feature:touch-of-death: When hitting a creature with a melee attack, Channel Divinity Charge can be used to deal extra 5 + 2 × (Cleric level) Necrotic damage.
feature:training-in-war-and-song: You gain proficiency with Light armour and in the Performance skill. You also gain proficiency with Daggers, Longswords, Rapiers, Scimitars, Shortswords, and Sickles.
feature:tranquillity: Long Rests surround you with an aura of peace, granting you Sanctuary permanently until you attack.
feature:transmutation-savant: Halves the cost to learn Transmutation spells from scrolls.
feature:transmuters-stone: Store some of your transmutation magic in a small stone. A creature carrying the stone gains a benefit of your choice.
feature:turn-the-faithless: Channel your Oath using ancient words to Turn nearby fey and fiends.
feature:turn-the-tide: Shout out and heal all nearby non-enemy creatures.
feature:turn-the-unholy: Turn nearby undead and fiends. They are forced to flee and cannot come close to you.
feature:turn-undead: Pray to Turn all undead that can see you.
feature:twinkling-constellations:
Your Starry Forms are improved. The Archer's damage and the Chalice's healing are each increased by 1d8, and the Dragon gains the ability to hover and to Fly at a movement speed of 6 m (20 ft).
Once per turn, you can switch to a different Starry Form as a free action.
feature:umbral-shroud: Wrap yourself in shadows to become Invisible if you are obscured.
feature:unarmoured-defence-barbarian: Your body is as resilient as any armour. While not wearing armour, you add your Constitution Modifier to your Armour Class.
feature:unarmoured-defence-monk: Your reflexes are as effective as any armour. While not wearing armour, you add your Wisdom Modifier to your Armour Class.
feature:unarmoured-movement: Your movement speed increases by 3 m (10 ft) while you are not wearing armour or using a shield.
feature:uncanny-dodge: Use your lightning-quick reflexes to protect yourself. When an attack hits you, you only take half the usual damage.
feature:undead-thralls-additional-undead: When you use Animate Dead, you can raise an additional corpse.
feature:undead-thralls-animate-dead: You gain the Animate Dead spell, if you didn't have it already
feature:undead-thralls-better-summons: Creatures created with Animate Dead have additional hit points equal to your wizard level, and your Proficiency Bonus is added to their damage.
feature:unrelenting-ferocity: Muster up your stamina to heal yourself.
feature:unstable-backlash: While enraged, when you take damage or fail a Saving Throw, you trigger another Wild Magic effect that replaces the current one.
feature:vapraks-greed: Your carrying capacity is increased by a quarter.
feature:volley: Fire a cascade of magical broadheads and bodkin arrows upon nearby foes.
feature:vow-of-enmity: Gain Advantage on Attack Rolls against an enemy.
feature:war-gods-blessing: Endow a nearby ally with the glory of your god to grant them a +10 bonus to their Attack Roll.
feature:war-magic: You have honed your body and magic for war. After you cast a cantrip, you can make a weapon attack using a Bonus Action.
feature:war-priest: When you make an unarmed or weapon attack, you can spend a War Priest Charge to make an additional attack as a Bonus Action.
feature:warding-flare: Shield yourself with divine light. Use your Reaction to impose Disadvantage on an attacker, possibly causing their attack to miss.
feature:weapon-bond: Ritually bind the weapon in your main hand. The weapon can't be knocked out of your hand, and it automatically returns to you when thrown.
feature:whirlwind-attack: Strike out at all nearby foes, making separate Attack Rolls against each target.
feature:wholeness-of-body: Regain half your Ki Points and enter a temporary state of Wholeness where you regain Ki Points and have an extra Bonus Action.
feature:wild-magic-sorcerer-surge:
Unruly magic sparks and fizzes through your veins.
Each time you cast a spell of Level 1 or higher, your magic might surge and trigger a random magical effect.
feature:wild-shape: Magically assume the shape of a beast.
feature:wild-shape-air-myrmidon: Take the shape of an Air Myrmidon.
feature:wild-shape-badger: Assume the shape of a giant badger that can Burrow into the ground. The badger has a starting health of 13 hit points that increases every two druid levels.
feature:wild-shape-bear: Assume the shape of a polar bear that can Goad enemies into attacking it. The polar bear has a starting health of 30 hit points that increases every two druid levels.
feature:wild-shape-cat: Take the shape of a cat that can avoid attention and Meow to distract enemies. It has 2 hit points.
feature:wild-shape-deep-rothe: Assume the shape of a Deep Rothé that casts Dancing Lights (Deep Rothé) and Charges its enemies. The deep rothé has a starting health of 23 hit points that increase every two druid levels.
feature:wild-shape-dilophosaurus: Take the shape of a dilophosaurus whose Corrosive Spit can dissolve a target's Armour Class.
feature:wild-shape-dire-raven: Take the shape of a Dire Raven that can avoid attention and Blind enemies. It has 13 hit points.
feature:wild-shape-earth-myrmidon: Take the shape of an Earth Myrmidon.
feature:wild-shape-fire-myrmidon: Take the shape of a Fire Myrmidon.
feature:wild-shape-improvement: Beast form attacks deal an extra 1d4 or 1d6 damage, depending on the form and attack. The die grows one size at level 8 and again at level 12.
feature:wild-shape-owlbear: Take the shape of an Owlbear that can Rupture the ground and become Enraged.
feature:wild-shape-panther: Take the shape of a panther that can Prowl around invisibly.
feature:wild-shape-sabre-toothed-tiger: Take the shape of a Sabre-Toothed Tiger that can Shred Armour and regenerate hit points.
feature:wild-shape-spider: Assume the shape of of a giant spider that can Enweb enemies. The giant spider has a starting health of 20 hit points that increases every two druid levels.
feature:wild-shape-water-myrmidon: Take the shape of a Water Myrmidon.
feature:wild-shape-wolf: Assume the shape of a dire wolf that can Incite allies and Distract enemies. The dire wolf has a starting health of 18 hit points that increase every two druid levels.
feature:wild-strike: You can make an additional Attack Roll after making an Unarmed Strike while in an animal Wild Shape.
feature:wrath-of-the-storm: As a Reaction strike back at an attacking creature, dealing 2d8 Lightning damage or 2d8 Thunder damage. The target takes half damage on a successful Saving Throw.
feature:writhing-tide: Condense part of your swarm into a mass that lifts you up. Gain a flying speed of 9 m (30 ft) and become unaffected by surface effects.
option:animal-aspects:bear:
The Aspect of the Bear infuses you with strength.
Your Carrying Capacity is doubled, and you have Advantage on Strength Checks.
option:animal-aspects:chimpanzee:
The Aspect of the Chimpanzee grants you a nimble mischievousness.
You gain Resistance to falling damage, and throwing camp supplies Blinds targets.
option:animal-aspects:crocodile:
The Aspect of the Crocodile increases your agility in the water.
Your Movement Speed increases by 3 m (10 ft) while standing in water-based surfaces.
On slippery surfaces, you also have Advantage on Saving Throws against being knocked Prone
option:animal-aspects:eagle:
The Aspect of the Eagle enhances your eyesight.
You can see in the dark up to 12 m (40 ft), and gain Advantage on Perception Checks.
option:animal-aspects:elk:
The Aspect of the Elk grants you astounding swiftness.
You can use Aspect of the Elk, giving yourself and nearby allies extra Movement Speed.
option:animal-aspects:honey-badger: If you're Poisoned, Frightened, or Charmed at the start of your turn, you have a 50% chance to begin Raging without expending a Rage Charge.
option:animal-aspects:stallion:
The Aspect of the Stallion creates safety in movement.
Dashing grants you temporary hit points equal to twice your Barbarian level.
option:animal-aspects:tiger:
The Aspect of the Tiger infuses you with an unrelenting ferocity.
You add an additional Strength Modifier to Attack Rolls against Bleeding or Poisoned targets, and gain Proficiency in Survival
option:animal-aspects:wolf:
The Aspect of the Wolf boosts your stealthiness.
You gain Proficiency in Stealth, and can use Aspect of the Wolf.
option:animal-aspects:wolverine:
The Aspect of the Wolverine grants you the tools to relentlessly pursue your prey.
When you attack a Bleeding or Poisoned target, you also Maim it for 1 turn
option:arcane-shots:banishing-arrow: Use Abjuration magic to potentially Banish your target to the Feywild.
option:arcane-shots:beguiling-arrow: Use Enchantment magic to deal an additional 2d6 Psychic damage. Target must succeed a Saving Throw or become Charmed.
option:arcane-shots:bursting-arrow: Use Evocation magic to make your arrow explode on impact and deal an additional 2d6 Force damage to targets within 5 m (17 ft).
option:arcane-shots:enfeebling-arrow: Use Necromatic magic to deal an additional 2d6 Necrotic damage. Target must succeed a Saving Throw or become Feeble.
option:arcane-shots:grasping-arrow: Deal an additional 2d6 Poison damage. Affected entity's movement speed is reduced by 3 m (10 ft) and it will take 2d6 Slashing damage when it moves.
option:arcane-shots:piercing-arrow: Use Transmutation magic to attack all those within the line of your shot. Each target must succeed a Saving Throw or be dealt an additional 1d6 Piercing damage.
option:arcane-shots:seeking-arrow:
Use Divination magic to make your arrow seek a target. The arrow deals an additional 1d6 Force damage and possibly applies Faerie Fire.
This arrow always hits its target.
option:arcane-shots:shadow-arrow: Use Illusion magic to deal an additional 2d6 Psychic damage. Target must succeed a Saving Throw or become Blinded.
option:bestial-hearts:bear-heart: While Raging, you can use Unrelenting Ferocity, and have Resistance to all damage except Psychic damage.
option:bestial-hearts:eagle-heart: While Raging, you can use Diving Strike. Foes also have Disadvantage on Opportunity Attacks against you, and you can use Dash as a bonus action.
option:bestial-hearts:elk-heart: While Raging, you can use Primal Stampede, and your movement speed increases by 4.5 m (15 ft).
option:bestial-hearts:tiger-heart: While Raging, you can use Tiger's Bloodlust, and your jump distance increases by 4.5 m (15 ft).
option:bestial-hearts:wolf-heart: While Raging, you can use Inciting Howl, and your allies have Advantage on melee Attack Rolls against enemies within 2 m (7 ft) of you.
option:eldritch-invocations:agonising-bl: When you cast Eldritch Blast, add your Charisma Modifier to the damage it deals, unless it is negative.
option:eldritch-invocations:armour-of-sh: You can cast Mage Armour on yourself at will, without expending a Spell Slot. Mage Armour increases your Armour Class when you are not wearing armour.
option:eldritch-invocations:beast-speech: You can cast Speak with Animals on yourself at will, without expending a Spell Slot.
option:eldritch-invocations:beguiling-in: You invoke your patron's bewitching charm. You gain Proficiency in Deception and Persuasion.
option:eldritch-invocations:book-of-anci:
You can inscribe magical rituals in your Book of Shadows. Gain Ray of Sickness, Chromatic Orb, and Silence spells.
You can cast them once per Long Rest and they don't expend spell slots
option:eldritch-invocations:devils-sight: You can see normally in darkness, both magical and non-magical, to a distance of 24 m (80 ft).
option:eldritch-invocations:dreadful-wor: You can cast Confusion with a Warlock spell slot.
option:eldritch-invocations:fiendish-vig: You can cast False Life on yourself at will as a 1st-level spell, without expending a Spell Slot.
option:eldritch-invocations:lifedrinker: Attacks made with your melee weapon deal additional necrotic damage equal to your Charisma modifier.
option:eldritch-invocations:mask-of-many: You can cast Disguise Self on yourself at will, without expending a Spell Slot.
option:eldritch-invocations:minions-of-c: You can cast Conjure Elemental with a Warlock spell slot.
option:eldritch-invocations:mire-the-min: You can cast Slow with a Warlock spell slot.
option:eldritch-invocations:one-with-sha: You learn how to cast One with Shadows.
option:eldritch-invocations:otherworldly: You can cast the Enhance Leap spell without expending a spell slot.
option:eldritch-invocations:repelling-bl: When you hit a creature with Eldritch Blast, you can push the creature up to 4.5 m (15 ft) away from you.
option:eldritch-invocations:sculptor-of-: You can cast Polymorph with a Warlock spell slot.
option:eldritch-invocations:sign-of-ill-: You can cast Bestow Curse with a Warlock Spell Slot.
option:eldritch-invocations:thief-of-fiv: Once per Long Rest, you can cast Bane using a Warlock Spell Slot.
option:eldritch-invocations:whispers-of-: You can cast Speak with Dead without expending a Warlock spell slot.
option:elemental-adept-elements:acid: Spells you cast and attacks you make ignore Resistance to Acid damage. In addition, when you deal Acid damage with a spell, you cannot roll a 1.
option:elemental-adept-elements:cold: Spells you cast and attacks you make ignore Resistance to Cold damage. In addition, when you deal Cold damage with a spell, you cannot roll a 1.
option:elemental-adept-elements:fire: Spells you cast and attacks you make ignore Resistance to Fire damage. In addition, when you deal Fire damage with a spell, you cannot roll a 1.
option:elemental-adept-elements:lightnin: Spells you cast and attacks you make ignore Resistance to Lightning damage. In addition, when you deal Lightning damage with a spell, you cannot roll a 1.
option:elemental-adept-elements:thunder: Spells you cast and attacks you make ignore Resistance to Thunder damage. In addition, when you deal Thunder damage with a spell, you cannot roll a 1.
option:elemental-disciplines:blade-of-ri: Throw a shard of ice that deals 1d10 Piercing damage. It explodes and deals 2d6 Cold to anyone nearby. It leaves an ice surface.
option:elemental-disciplines:chill-of-th: Call forth the cold mountain winds and reduce the target's movement speed by 3 m (10 ft).
option:elemental-disciplines:clench-of-t: Hold a humanoid enemy still. They can't move, act or react. Attacks from within 3 m (10 ft) are always critical hits.
option:elemental-disciplines:embrace-of-: Expel the fire burning through your veins as 3 flaming rays. Each ray deals 2d6 Fire.
option:elemental-disciplines:fangs-of-th: Hit foes from afar. Your next melee attacks deal an additional 1d4 Fire damage.
option:elemental-disciplines:fist-of-fou: Release a wave of thunderous force that pushes away all creatures and objects.
option:elemental-disciplines:fist-of-unb: Push the target back 6 m (20 ft) and knock it Prone.
option:elemental-disciplines:flames-of-t: Shoot a bright flame from your fingers that explodes upon contact, torching everything in the vicinity
option:elemental-disciplines:gong-of-the: Damages all nearby creatures and objects. Creatures made of inorganic material such as stone have Disadvantage on their Saving Throw.
option:elemental-disciplines:mist-stance: Transform into a tiny gas cloud. It can't fall, and fits through small openings. It is very hard to damage.
option:elemental-disciplines:rush-of-the: Summon a strong wind that clears all clouds and pushes creatures back 5 m (17 ft), forcing them Off Balance.
option:elemental-disciplines:sphere-of-e:
Hurl a sphere of energy.
It deals 3d8 Thunder damage, or 2d8 Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Poison damage and creates a surface.
option:elemental-disciplines:sweeping-ci: Expel fire from your outstretched hands and ignite anything flammable.
option:elemental-disciplines:touch-of-th: The target cannot use reactions. This spell has Advantage on creatures with metal armour.
option:elemental-disciplines:water-whip: Possibly pulls a target 9 m (30 ft) toward you or knocks it Prone.
option:fighting-styles:archery: You gain a +2 bonus to Attack Rolls you make with ranged Weapons.
option:fighting-styles:defence: You gain a +1 bonus to Armour Class while wearing armour.
option:fighting-styles:duelling: When you are wielding a melee weapon that is not Two-Handed in one hand, and no weapon in the other, you deal an additional 2 damage with that weapon.
option:fighting-styles:great-weapon-figh: When you roll a 1 or 2 on a damage die for an attack with a Two-Handed melee weapon, that die is rerolled once.
option:fighting-styles:protection: When you have a Shield, impose Disadvantage on an enemy who attacks one of your allies when you are within 1.5 m (5 ft). You must be able to see the enemy.
option:fighting-styles:two-weapon-fighti: When you make an offhand attack, you can add your Ability Score Modifier to the damage of the attack.
option:gathered-swarms:cloud-of-jellyfis: You gain a swarm of jellyfish that fights on your side. Once per round, the swarm can assist you in one of three ways after you attack an enemy: it can attack and deal additional Lightning damage, Shock your enemy, or teleport you to a safer location.
option:gathered-swarms:flurry-of-moths: You gain a swarm of moths that fights on your side. Once per round, the swarm can assist you in one of three ways after you attack an enemy: it can attack and deal additional Psychic damage, Blind your enemy, or teleport you to a safer location.
option:gathered-swarms:legion-of-bees: You gain a swarm of bees that fights on your side. Once per round, the swarm can assist you in one of three ways after you attack an enemy: it can attack and deal additional Piercing damage, push the enemy away from you, or teleport you to a safer location.
option:hunter-defensive-tactics:escape-t: Opportunity Attacks against you have Disadvantage.
option:hunter-defensive-tactics:multiatt: When an enemy attacks you, they have a -4 penalty to additional Attack Rolls against you until the start of their next turn.
option:hunter-defensive-tactics:steel-wi: Advantage on Saving Throws against being Frightened.

option:manoeuvres:disarming-attack: Focus your attack on your foe's hands and possibly force them to drop the weapons they are holding.
option:manoeuvres:distracting-strike: Distract the target, giving your allies Advantage on their next attack roll against it.

option:pact-boons:pact-of-the-chain: Gain the service of a familiar, a fey spirit that takes a form of your choosing. This can be an animal, imp, or quasit.
option:pact-boons:pact-of-the-tome: Your patron grants you a grimoire called "The Book of Shadows", which allows you to cast Guidance, Vicious Mockery, and Thorn Whip.

option:ranger-favoured-enemies:keeper-of: You specialise in hunting creatures from other planes of existence. You gain Proficiency in Arcana and can grant protection against aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, and undead.
option:ranger-favoured-enemies:mage-brea: You have a history of battling spellcasters. You gain Proficiency in Arcana and can cast True Strike.
option:ranger-favoured-enemies:ranger-kn: You have sworn to serve a crown or nation and seek to bring its foes to ruin. Gain Proficiency with History and Proficiency with Heavy Armour.
option:ranger-favoured-enemies:sanctifie: You swore to hunt the enemies of a holy or druidic order. You gain Proficiency in Religion and can cast Sacred Flame.
option:ranger-natural-explorers:beast-ta: You have cultivated a strong bond with animals. You can cast Find Familiar without expending a spell slot.
option:ranger-natural-explorers:urban-tr: An expert at navigating the wild within the city, you gain Sleight of Hand Proficiency.

spell:vicious-mockery: Insult a creature: it has Disadvantage on its next Attack Roll.
spell:wall-of-fire: Create a blazing wall of fire, Burning anyone who dares stand too close. Deals Fire to anything that moves into or ends its turn in the area.
spell:wall-of-ice: Raise a wall of solid ice that deals 10d6 Cold damage to anyone standing in its way.
spell:wall-of-stone:
Raise a wall of non-magical, solid stone.
The wall can be created between any two points within range as long as there is a clear path between them. It is made up of Stone Pillars with 30 HP each, immune to Psychic and vulnerable to Force and Thunder damage. Pillars block movement and line of sight.
spell:wall-of-thorns: Create a wall of pliable, twisting thorns surrounded by Entangling vines.
spell:warden-of-vitality: While this aura lasts, you can cast Restore Vitality as a Bonus Action to heal yourself or nearby allies by 2d6 hit points.
spell:warding-bond: Ward an ally. They gain resistance to all damage, and a +1 bonus to their Armour Class and Saving Throws.
spell:web:
Cover an area in thick, flammable webbing that can Enweb creatures within.
An ally can use its Help action to try and tear away the webs.
spell:wind-walk: Transform yourself and all nearby party members into tiny clouds of mist to avoid attacks.
spell:witch-bolt: Link yourself to a target with a bolt of lightning. Deal an additional 1d12 Lightning damage each turn by activating it.
spell:wrathful-smite: Your weapon absorbs your wrath as you strike, possibly Frightening your target.
